note: Cast for the pre-level stand-off. All PNGs are RGBA with the figure cut out and a soft dark halo in the alpha, 1024x1536 except the American at 1145x1374. All ten are drawn: the five second-half defenders (mx, it, ru, au, br) arrived as a set in the same style as the first four — cigar, arms folded, flag worn as a cape or patch, national headgear.

player.role: The player's commander — appears on every level, bottom-left
player.look: Four-star general, helmet with five stars, stars-and-stripes aviators, cigar, pointing finger, swagger stick in the other hand

scripts.note: The stand-off before each level: three beats, player / defender / player. Lines verbatim from the writer for the first four levels; the Taj alternate and the five second-half levels (chichen, pisa, moscow, sydney, rio) are drafted here and are marked as drafts in src/game/cast.js.

westminster.line: Give it up you limey bastard
God save the queen, and your soul
Thank god, I was worried we dragged this ordnance across the Atlantic for nothing!

paris.line: All I heard was baguette, and that's all I need

agra.line: Nice tomb. Vacate the premises before I add to the occupancy.
Twenty thousand men built this in twenty-two years. You have four guns and a hangover.
Twenty-two years? Give me twenty-two minutes.

agra_alt.line: That's a hell of a headstone. Move it or lose it, chief.
It was built for love, sahib. You would not understand — no one has ever loved you.
Love, huh? Boys, show him how much I love a 155.

giza.line: God it's hot out here, give it up before we all melt would ya?
اطلع الهرم ده وهاتك يا طفل يا تخين
I don't speak Sanskrit habibi, but I get the gist. Someone get me some damn water and a lot of bombs

chichen.line: Step aside, chief. We do not negotiate with calendars.
Llevas mil años tarde. Esto ya lo enterramos una vez y lo volvimos a construir encima.
Built it twice, huh? Well hell, that is half my work done for me.

pisa.line: That thing is already falling over. Save us both the ammunition.
Pende da ottocento anni, americano. Tu non duri otto minuti in questo sole.
Eight hundred years of leaning. Let us call it a running start.

moscow.line: Nine churches. I brought enough for ten.
Иван ослепил зодчего, чтобы он не построил второго. Тебе глаза оставим — смотри.
I did not catch a word of that, but he sounded real confident about it.

sydney.line: You are on a point with water on three sides. Where exactly are you going?
Mate, you have got one road in and we have got the whole harbour. Take your shot.
Finally, one of them speaks English. Does not make him right.

rio.line: Seven hundred metres up with no road out. Walk down or be carried.
Ele está de braços abertos há um século. Nem por você ele abaixa.
Arms out like that? Son, that is not a welcome, that is a target.

westminster.defends: Elizabeth Tower and the Palace of Westminster
westminster.look: Field marshal, peaked cap with crown badge, Union flag patch, riding crop, cigar, arms folded

paris.defends: Eiffel Tower and the Palais de Chaillot
paris.look: Napoleonic marshal, bicorne with tricolore plume and cockade, epaulettes, sabre, cigar, arms folded

agra.look: Maharaja-general, tricolour turban with pearls and plume, cream tunic with gold cords, Ashoka lion buckle, tulwar, cigar, arms folded

giza.look: Field marshal, peaked cap with eagle, Egyptian flag patch and belt plate, khaki service dress, sabre, cigar, arms folded

chichen.defends: El Castillo and the Temple of the Warriors
chichen.look: General in black charro dress with gold filigree, wide embroidered sombrero with the eagle-and-serpent, red bow, bandolier, silver-tooled holster and boots with spurs, Mexican flag patch, a serape in the flag's colours over one shoulder, cigar, arms folded

pisa.defends: The campanile, the Duomo and the Baptistery
pisa.look: Generale in olive service dress, maroon paratrooper beret with the winged badge, red neckerchief, ITALIA shield patch, medals, sabre with a tricolore tassel, the tricolore worn as a cape, cigar, arms folded

moscow.defends: Saint Basil's Cathedral and the Kremlin wall
moscow.look: Marshal in grey-green greatcoat with red piping and gold aigulettes, black fur hat with the double-headed eagle, fur-collared cape lined red, Russian flag patch, chestful of medals, holstered revolver and gilt sabre, cigar, arms folded

sydney.defends: The Opera House on Bennelong Point
sydney.look: General in Australian camouflage, slouch hat with the rising-sun badge and one side pinned up, shemagh, AUSTRALIA name tape, flag patch, kangaroo tattoo reading AUSSIE AUSSIE AUSSIE, a can of VB in a kangaroo stubby holder on the belt, knife, the Australian flag worn as a cape, cigar, arms folded

rio.defends: Christ the Redeemer on the Corcovado
rio.look: Marechal in dark green dress uniform heavy with gold cord and stars, peaked cap with the national arms, medals, gilt sabre, Brazilian flag patch and the flag worn as a cape, cigar, arms folded
